name: Pars Kit – پارس کیت
author: ابرانا

sections.description:
Pars Kit is a lightweight, fast, and compact plugin for WooCommerce. It brings the practical tools Iranian stores need into one plugin.

Each feature stands on its own. Enable only the tools you need.

📆 Jalali (Shamsi) dates:

WordPress and WooCommerce dates are shown in the Jalali (Shamsi) calendar in the admin, on the site, in calendars, in date fields, and in emails.

The WooCommerce Analytics section and report date ranges are shown entirely in the Jalali calendar.

Date conversion is display-only. Dates stored in the database stay unchanged.

💳 Iranian bank payment gateways:

Pars Kit includes these Iranian bank payment gateways:

  • Behpardakht Mellat
  • Saman
  • Parsian (PEC)
  • Pasargad
  • Sadad (Bank Melli)
  • Iran Kish
  • Pardakht Novin Arian

🚀 Optimization and Speed ​​Enhancement:

Automatic WebP conversion — Images uploaded to the site are automatically converted to WebP, compressed, and reduced in size, without a loss of quality, so pages load much faster.

Limit outbound connections — You choose the allowed domains and apply the limit to the admin, the site, or both. Requests to domains outside that list are blocked, which speeds up the admin and the store, especially on hosting inside Iran.

✅ Admin activity log:

When this section is enabled, activity by users with administrative access to the admin is recorded in detail.

The username, IP address, date, time, and the action itself are stored. Filters by field and date range make review easier.

🧰 Useful WordPress and WooCommerce tools:

You can turn each tool on or off separately, with one click:

  • Vazirmatn in the admin — The Vazirmatn Persian font in the WordPress admin.
  • Faster admin — Optimize the WordPress admin and make it faster.
  • Jalali order date filter — On the WooCommerce orders screen, search by a date or a date range.
  • Persian first and last name — On the checkout page, the first and last name are accepted only in Persian letters.
  • Hide the price when a product is out of stock — When a product is out of stock, its price is hidden on the shop and the product page.

✉️ SMTP email:

When SMTP is enabled, outgoing WordPress and WooCommerce email is sent through the server you enter in the plugin settings, and more messages are delivered successfully.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress.org, or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate Pars Kit.
  3. Open Pars Kit and enable the tools you need.
  4. For a bank gateway, after you enable it, enter the gateway details under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
sections.changelog:
2.1.26

  • Tools: keep the out-of-stock price in WooCommerce emails even when they run inside Store API / Blocks checkout.

2.1.25

  • Tools: keep the out-of-stock price on cron, WP-CLI, feeds, and WooCommerce emails.

2.1.24

  • Mellat: disable XML external entities around SoapClient on PHP 7.4 (same XXE guard as Parsian).

2.1.23

  • Gateways: store only a masked last-four PAN on Melli, Novin, Pasargad, and Iran Kish (same as Mellat and Parsian). Bank cardNumber fallbacks are not saved in order meta.

2.1.22

  • Gateways: a successful bank return finds the pending order again (Mellat SaleOrderId is compared as a number). Cancel still returns to checkout with the cart.

2.1.21

  • Gateways: convert the order total to Rials from the order currency (WC_Order::get_currency), not the current store currency.

2.1.20

  • Admin bar: Vazirmatn no longer forces dashicons onto every .ab-item::before, so third-party toolbar icon fonts keep working.

2.1.19

  • Admin icons: Vazirmatn no longer forces the dashicons font onto every menu :before, so plugin icon fonts keep working. The blocker keeps official add_menu_page SVG data URIs and the core dashicons font.

2.1.18

  • Tools: hide out-of-stock prices on the storefront and Store API only. The admin products list, wp-admin Ajax, and wc/v3 REST keep the real price.

2.1.17

  • Tools: hide the out-of-stock price on the shop, categories, search, and other catalog views, not only the single product page (woocommerce_get_price_html).

2.1.16

  • Parsian: transport errors from wp_remote_post are retried as HTTP failures, matching the other gateways. After a successful reverse, the order is failed so checkout can mint a new token; only an unsuccessful reverse stays on-hold.

2.1.15

  • Parsian: after a cancelled or failed bank return, the sale session is cleared so the next checkout mints a new token instead of reusing the cancelled one. A confirm status after a transport retry is held for review. SOAP parsing on PHP 7.4 disables external entities.

2.1.14

  • Parsian (PEC) payment gateway, after Saman. Sale, confirm, and reverse use the bank SOAP service with certificate verification

2.1.13

  • Docs: cancelled or expired bank payments stay on checkout; the cart is kept until payment succeeds and the next checkout uses current cart prices

2.1.12

  • Cancelled or expired bank payments return to checkout with the cart still intact so the customer can pay again

2.1.11

  • Packaging bump after review against the project spec and current WordPress and WooCommerce APIs

2.1.10

  • Updates and a few minor fixes
